components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: A pill in ink, metal, paper, glass, outline or ghost, with a field of dithered dots while it loads.

components.name: hold-button
components.title: Hold button
components.description: Press and hold to confirm: ink fills it as you hold, and letting go early cancels.

components.name: copy-button
components.title: Copy button
components.description: Copies a piece of text, its icon turning over into a check as a ring spreads from it.

components.name: command-line
components.title: Command line
components.description: A shell command on a small ink terminal, colored, with a copy button and a switch between package managers.

components.name: input
components.title: Input
components.description: A text field pressed into the page that lifts to a white face as you type, with room for an icon or a suffix.

components.name: textarea
components.title: Textarea
components.description: A longer field that grows as you type, with a small ring that counts toward its limit.

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch
components.description: A recessed track that fills with ink, and a bead for a knob that stretches while you press it.

components.name: segmented
components.title: Segmented control
components.description: One choice of a few in a machined track, the chosen one on a raised thumb that slides.

components.name: slider
components.title: Slider
components.description: A value along an ink track: a bead to drag, a bubble that says the value, and marked stops under it.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.description: A quiet row of names, the selected one inked on a pill that slides, its panel rising in.

components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: Numbered questions on one card, each answer springing open as its plus turns into a cross.

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
components.description: A small stamp in ink, gray, outline, paper or metal, with a status dot that can pulse.

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: A card on a plain surface or on paper, with an optional brushed-metal edge.

components.name: avatar
components.title: Avatar
components.description: Initials on a stone tint drawn from the name, a status dot, and a group that fans out when you point at it.

components.name: kbd
components.title: Kbd
components.description: A keycap that goes down when you press its key on your keyboard.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: An ink bubble with a caret, carrying the action's shortcut on small caps.

components.name: meter
components.title: Meter
components.description: Progress drawn in dots, its edge dissolving through an ordered dither and springing as it moves.
